Every published image that differs visibly from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026); the <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of one date are one publication.
* '''Original''' ([[Ahch-To: Saddle (ALT)]]): Alternate-image card image published 10 August 2021<ref name="img-Original">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/25e5dad5826a9bb8e047c10fe325460bda7a7edc/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png holotable commit 25e5dad], 10 August 2021) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: May ▼ [Episode VII] Luke here. Once per turn, if Luke alone here, may subtract 2 from opponent's total power during a battle at another location.” Alternate-image card first published 10 August 2021 in the PC's alternate-image pack (holotable 25e5dad, “Virtual AI pack series 2”: PNG 1039×745 only; no GIF copy yet).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ahch-To: Saddle (ALT) (Errata)]]): Alternate-image card image published 15 January 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif holotable commit 793bf65], 15 January 2022); <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/17b52a9d067da2342f96b495fd63482ea55b8dcd/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png holotable commit 17b52a9], 15 January 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: May ▼ [Episode VII] Luke here. Once per turn, if Luke alone here, may subtract 2 from opponent's total power during a battle at another location.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the alternate image (holotable 17b52a9, “Alternate Image updates”, PNG 1039×745, and the first GIF copy 793bf65, 745×534, 15 January 2022): the art is re-cropped and re-coloured, the title bar and text box are smaller and sit higher, the Set 10 icon moved to the right of the text box, an [Episode VII] icon was added at the top of the right border, and the line down the right border “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” became “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”. Words unchanged.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Ahch-To: Saddle (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): Alternate-image card image published 11 June 2022<ref name="img-PC-E2">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif holotable commit 6894629], 11 June 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: May ▼ [Episode VII] Luke here. Once per turn, if Luke alone here, may subtract 2 from opponent's total power during a battle at another location.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the GIF copy (the file the PC card data uses) at a larger size, 745×534 → 1039×745 pixels, with its new GIF maker (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”, 11 June 2022, which re-made the landscape GIFs of Virtual Sets 4 and 14–18 and 11 alternate-image cards; the new file is PNG data kept under the <code>.gif</code> name). It is the same card enlarged — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged; the new GIF is pixel-for-pixel the high-resolution PNG copy the PC had published on 15 January 2022 (<code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png</code>), which until then appeared only in the <code>hires</code> folder. A visible (resolution) change of the card image, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): Alternate-image card image published 12 December 2022 (current; the image the PC card data uses)<ref name="img-PC-E3">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif holotable commit 12d0bca], 12 December 2022); <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png holotable commit e9980f9], 11 December 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: May ▼ [Episode VII] Luke here. Once per turn, if Luke alone here, may subtract 2 from opponent's total power during a battle at another location.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC added the Players Committee logo beside “(AI)” at the lower left (holotable e9980f9, “Set 20 Errata, 2020 AIs, and a few fixes”, PNG, 11 December 2022; GIF 12d0bca, 12 December 2022). Words and art unchanged.
